_note: Every 'prompt' is a fragment, kept short on purpose: measured in QwenStudio, about 35 words naming wardrobe, place and light keeps the face; 60 words of generic photograph loses it. 'thumb' is the prompt the catalogue thumbnail was generated from, with no person in it unless the card needs one.
